title: Tech Fusion 2026 begins at KU’s Zakura Campus, focuses on drones, robotics, IoT, 5G

ai.summary: University of Kashmir launched Tech Fusion 2026, a five-day hands-on workshop program for students to learn drone technology, robotics, IoT, 5G systems, and civil engineering practices.

facts.claim: The Institute of Technology (IoT), Zakura Campus, University of Kashmir (KU), commenced Tech Fusion 2026 – 'Learn, Build, Innovate', a five-day programme of hands-on workshops on emerging technologies and engineering practices.
facts.quote: The Institute of Technology (IoT), Zakura Campus, University of Kashmir (KU), commenced Tech Fusion 2026 – 'Learn, Build, Innovate', a five-day programme of hands-on workshops on emerging technologies and engineering practices.

facts.claim: The programme aims to give students practical exposure to new technologies, strengthen their technical skills and help them understand how classroom concepts are applied in real-world engineering.
facts.quote: The programme aims to give students practical exposure to new technologies, strengthen their technical skills and help them understand how classroom concepts are applied in real-world engineering.

facts.claim: Vice-Chancellor KU, Prof. Nilofer Khan said that engineering education must provide students with opportunities to learn by doing and working with emerging technologies.
facts.quote: Speaking at the inaugural session, Vice-Chancellor KU, Prof. Nilofer Khan said that engineering education must provide students with opportunities to learn by doing and working with emerging technologies.

facts.claim: The five-day programme includes five specialised workshop categories: Drone Technology, Hands-on Robotics and IoT (Internet of Things), Hands-on 5G Systems, Engineering through Practice and Experimental Techniques in Civil Engineering.
facts.quote: The five-day programme includes five specialised workshop categories: Drone Technology, Hands-on Robotics and IoT (Internet of Things), Hands-on 5G Systems, Engineering through Practice and Experimental Techniques in Civil Engineering.
